result.summary: The intersection features signalized pedestrian crossings with high-visibility continental markings and curb ramps. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance without a median refuge, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for a long duration without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The main crosswalk spanning the multi-lane road in the foreground.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing essential infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like medians or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry on the right allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians halfway across the street, allowing them to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and a well-maintained sidewalk on the right side. However, the wide roadway and lack of a pedestrian refuge island or visible pedestrian signals increase exposure and risk for those crossing.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-point refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection to indicate safe crossing times.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming or refuge islands increase exposure for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, which can endanger pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.
